name: Nocte Zolpidem 10mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Ambien®)
short: Nocte® Zolpidem 10 mg, 30 tablets — sedative-hypnotic indicated for short-term treatment of insomnia. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Nocte® is the Mexican brand of zolpidem 10 mg, a non-benzodiazepine sedative-hypnotic indicated for the short-term treatment of insomnia, specifically difficulty initiating sleep. Each tablet contains zolpidem tartrate 10 mg, and this presentation includes 30 tablets.

Zolpidem acts selectively on GABA-A receptors to facilitate sleep onset, with shorter half-life than traditional benzodiazepines. Use should be limited in duration; dosing should be individualized by your prescriber, particularly in older adults. Consult your healthcare provider before starting this medication.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the corridor. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
